title: Dagster Run Failures by Job
dataSources: Dagster logs (`dagster:daemon`, `dagster:run`), GraphQL run/asset queries, and structured event-log JSON (`dagster:event`).
app: Dagster daemon and run-worker logs via Universal Forwarder; Dagster GraphQL API and event-log records via HEC scripted inputs; Dagster instance storage (run/event tables) via Splunk DB Connect.
spl:
index=bi sourcetype=dagster:event event_type="PIPELINE_FAILURE" OR event_type="RUN_FAILURE"
| stats count as failures, values(run_id) as run_ids by job_name
| sort - failures
description: Counts Dagster run/pipeline failure events per job so data teams see which jobs are failing and can jump straight to the failing run IDs.
value: Job failures break downstream assets and dashboards; ranking by job focuses remediation on the pipelines causing the most damage.
implementation: Emit Dagster event-log records to HEC (or query instance storage via DB Connect); schedule every 10 minutes and alert on any failure for a critical job.
visualization: Table of job by failure count with run IDs, timechart.
grandmaExplanation: We tell you which data-pipeline jobs are failing in Dagster so they can be fixed before the reports that depend on them go stale.
